The '''1933–34 season''' was '''[[Real Madrid CF|Madrid Football Club]]'s''' [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|32nd season]] in existence, and their [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time La Liga table|6th consecutive season]] in the [[La Liga|Primera División]]. The club also played in the [[Campeonato Regional Centro|Campeonato Regional Mancomunado]] (Joint Regional Championship) and the [[Copa del Rey|Copa del Presidente de la República]] (President of the Republic's Cup).

==Summary==
During summer the club as Incumbent League Champions reinforced the squad with young players such as Mexican midfielder [[José Ramón Sauto]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mediotiempo.com/futbol/internacional/noticias/2014/09/01/ch14-cuarto-mexicano-en-el-real-madrid |title='CH14', cuarto mexicano en el Real Madrid | publisher=Mediotiempo |date=1 September 2014 |accessdate=2014-09-01}}</ref> Villanueva and [[Emilio Alonso Larrazabal|Emilin]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Tomás Aguirre Lecube|url=http://pares.mcu.es/MovimientosMigratorios/viewer2Controller.form?accion=4&nid=449&txt_id_imagen=1&txt_rotar=0&txt_contraste=0&appOrigen=|website=pares.mcu.es/MovimientosMigratorios|publisher=Secretaría de Estado de Cultura de España( Spanish Government)|accessdate=18 January 2017}}</ref> In Autumn the team won the [[Campeonato Regional Centro|regional championship]] and by December the Board fired [[Robert Firth (footballer)|Firth]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2016/12/05/58454433e5fdea936f8b4579.html|title=Zidane Equals Mister Firth 1933 Record|publisher=marca.com|date=5 December 2016|accessdate=5 December 2020}}</ref> following a landslide defeat 0–5 against Athletic Bilbao. After two matches without coach, in January the Executive Board appointed [[Francisco Bru]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://en.as.com/en/2017/10/13/album/1507915827_472195.html|title=Real Madrid's Most decorated  managers of all time|date=13 October 2017|accessdate=13 December 2020|language=es}}</ref> as new manager and the squad finished second, two points below [[Athletic Bilbao]].

Meanwhile, in the [[1934 Copa del Presidente de la República]] Madrid reached the [[1934 Copa del Presidente de la República Final|final]] where it faced [[Valencia CF|Valencia Football Club]]. With a superb performance of Captain Ricardo Zamora, the team clinched its sixth Spanish Cup.
